n5a48626b19.headline: Mass closure of pension accounts warned by ENPF
n5a48626b19.summary: Kazakhstan's Unified Accumulative Pension Fund (ENPF) will close pension accounts that have no savings starting March 1, according to ENPF press service.
n5a48626b19.why: ENPF is Kazakhstan's main pension fund, and this policy affects millions of contributors and the country's pension system stability.
